projectDescription: A clinical research recruitment platform that identifies, screens, and delivers pre-qualified participants matched to your study's eligibility criteria.
keyFeatures: 4,000+ eligibility parameters covering conditions, medications, and numeric criteria
Geographic scoping from ZIP radius up to statewide or nationwide
Automated enrollment goal balancing across multiple sites
Formula-driven, study-specific pricing based on real geographic and recruitability data
HIPAA-compliant platform with executed Business Associate Agreements
IRB library of pre-approved text, imagery, and recruiting channel materials
Full audit log (21 CFR Part 11-aligned) for regulatory and sponsor reviews
Support for autonomous clinics, research organizations, and site networks
Decentralized, virtual, hybrid, and survey-based study support
Multi-organization collaboration with scoped role-based access control
Dedicated liaison assigned to every organization
publicApiSurface: Study setup: parameters, geos, enrollment goals
Study lifecycle: launch, pause, resume, amend protocol
